newsitem.title: MEXICO: GMexico sees 97 copper content output at 420,000 T.
newsitem.headline: GMexico sees 97 copper content output at 420,000 T.

text.p: Grupo Mexico, Mexico's largest mining concern, anticipates its copper content production to be around 410,000-420,000 tonnes this year, Deputy Finance Director Carlos Oyanguren said.
"It could work out that this year our copper content production will be 410,000, 420,000 tonnes," Oyanguren said in an interview with Reuters on Monday.
GMexico is by far the largest copper miner and copper smelter/refiner in the country.

Oyanguren said the increase in copper content output (up from the 325,869 tonnes of total copper content from smelters and cathode plants in 1996) would come largely because of GMexico's expansion of its La Caridad smelter to 300,000 tonnes per year from a previous capacity of 180,000 tonnes.
The smelter expansion, which came on line in March-April this year, was currently operating at levels of 95-96 percent, at an annualized rate of 290,000 to 293,000 tonnes, Oyanguren added.
